desc:
This is an RPG made by Koreans.

This is an RPG game in the nuclear and slash genre, with a retro animation style.

- Various professions and profession trees! 
- It's not just about increasing one stat, but exploring different stat routes.

It's up to you to increase the stats. The goal of this game is to immerse you in romance and fun.

(This game is being developed by the former co-representative of Alpigi without a title. It should be noted that there is no relationship between Alpigi without a title and the current game.) (This is not a sequel.)

The game is in development. We would appreciate it if you could report any bugs or issues to the community.

A total of 3 people are currently developing.

[ BGM : SMILEGATE , STOVE , Distokid ]
